_about: What the rest take's model happened to write, remarked on where it is read (build_storyboard.py, REST_NOTES; "p<i>" after passage i, counted without the judges' letters). Rewritten for each retake. Take: build/rec_rest, up to the job menu.
p1: Empathy feels something out of place here, a corner of land touched in an unusual way. Nothing at the farm backs it up. Read it as this mind's own way of seeing: a thought, not a clue.
p4: Diligence judges the act by its own measure: the care stayed the same from first to last. And look at the last line. Doing it taught a new way of thinking, Social Interaction, and from now on it can write replies too.
p7: Nautical Jargon talks like a sailor, even in a barn. Odd minds make odd replies, and some of the best moments in a run come from them.
p9: She says ten copper. The job menu will say one. The model rewrites a fixed line, and now and then it gets a number wrong. The menu is the rule; trust the menu.
p13: That last sentence is the farmer's own, slightly mad pride. Read it as a woman who has heard every doubt about her farm, and outlasted them all.
advice_asking: My advice: when a conversation matters, pick replies written by your strongest minds. Their levels become dice in that final roll.
job_done: The conversation was the hard part. The job itself is just a menu.
